text:
Anna (PM): Quick sync — we need a concrete, minimal launch-acceptance checklist for the new inference routing + SLA policies. Goal: lock scope and owners by tomorrow EOD.
Mike (Eng): Agree. Can we be explicit about latency SLOs vs. SLA? Eng can meet p50/p95 targets but public SLA needs legal + sales signoff.
Katie (Product Ops): Proposed acceptance items in one place would help. I'll collate once we agree list + owners.
Anna (PM): Draft minimal checklist below — please reply with owner initials or :+1: if OK.
```
- SLA: regional uptime SLA (target 99.9%), incident MTTR < 4h for severity 1
- Performance SLOs (internal): p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms for typical 1k token calls
- Docs: Quickstart, Runbook (oncall steps), Migration note for Dedicated/Private customers
- Support: Oncall rotation + escalation path; enterprise 24/7 for committed customers
- Monitoring: per-route latency, error-rate, token-cost telemetry + regression alerts
- Pricing readiness: published SKU + uplift for Dedicated and Private + example cost calc
- Rollout policy: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error thresholds
```
Marco (Sales): Need explicit "enterprise SLA opt-in" language. Also add a line: "exceptions & credits procedure" so sales can negotiate. I'll own that.
Liz (Docs): I can do Quickstart + migration note. Runbook needs input from Joel on play-by-play. ETA: 2 business days after owners confirmed.
Joel (SRE): I'll draft runbook snippets and escalation steps. Also want a small runbook checklist for the Dedicated handoff (network creds, KMS, VPC).
Ranjit (Support): What does 24/7 mean for us? If enterprise customers opt-in we need staffing plan. Recommend: Tiered oncall — enterprise automated paging + SE on-call for first 60m, then huddle. I can propose rota.
Mike (Eng): A couple of technical notes:
- need a fallback model policy when primary capacity exhausted (auto-route to smaller model)
- tracing hook + request-id must be present in prod logs for 100% of calls
- include a small config snippet for canary rollout:
```yaml
rollout:
  strategy: traffic_split
  stages:
    - pct: 10
      duration: 60m
    - pct: 50
      duration: 120m
    - pct: 100
```
Anna (PM): Good calls. For SLA definition, legal wants exact credit calc; Marco will lead. For pricing readiness, Finance needs example cost-per-1M tokens for hosted vs. dedicated.
Marco (Sales): I'll loop in Finance today. Also flagging that customers will ask about custom SLAs for Private deployments — we should add a "negotiable SLA appendix" item.
Katie (Product Ops): Action list:
- Marco: SLA exceptions & credits procedure (owner: Marco) — due: 1972176000
- Liz: Quickstart + Migration note (owner: Liz) — due: 1972262400
- Joel: Runbook + Dedicated handoff checklist (owner: Joel) — due: 1972190000
- Ranjit: Support rota proposal (owner: Ranjit) — due: 1972180000
- Mike: Canary config + fallback policy docs (owner: Mike) — due: 1972170000
- Katie: Collate and publish acceptance checklist (owner: Katie) — due: 1972270000
OpsBot: Deployment window scheduled for 1972130000 -> 1972133600, staging -> prod canary enabled.
Anna (PM): If everyone agrees, I'll mark this as the launch acceptance baseline and escalate blockers at tomorrow triage. Please add objections here now.
Mike (Eng): :+1: except I'll need an extra day if the fallback model requires additional validation.
Ranjit (Support): Noted — will sync with hiring manager about 24/7 coverage needs.
Liz (Docs): :+1: Will start after owners confirmed.
Marco (Sales): :+1: I'll coordinate with Finance and Legal.
Joel (SRE): One more request: add a health-check endpoint requirement for customer probes. That'll make Dedicated handoff simpler.
Anna (PM): Good call — added. Thanks everyone. I'll update the shared doc with these owners and deadlines.
Katie (Product Ops): I'll post the collated checklist to #product-updates once published.
Anna (PM): Closing for now — reach out if anything else pops up.
